info.title: PiAPI/DiffRhythm Universal API
info.description: Create DiffRhythm music-generation tasks, upload reference audio for style guidance, and check PiAPI task and account status.

post.description: Creates a temporary file upload in PiAPI/DiffRhythm.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

fileName.description: File name including a supported extension such as `.mp3`, `.wav`, `.png`, or `.jpg`.

fileData.description: Base64-encoded file content. PiAPI also accepts a matching data URI.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a DiffRhythm audio task in PiAPI/DiffRhythm.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

taskType.description: Choose `txt2audio-base` for shorter generations or `txt2audio-full` for longer songs.

input.lyrics.description: Timed lyrics in DiffRhythm format such as `[00:10.00] line of lyrics`.

input.stylePrompt.description: Describe the musical style, genre, or mood when you are not using a reference audio file.

input.styleAudio.description: Optional reference audio URL or Base64 string to guide the generated style.

config.webhookConfig.endpoint.description: Optional webhook URL for PiAPI task completion callbacks.

config.webhookConfig.secret.description: Optional secret that PiAPI includes when calling your webhook.
